groups.title: Retry idempotent HTTP requests with exponential backoff
groups.why: New HttpConfig.retries/retryDelayMs options (declared, defaulted, loaded from env) are consumed by the retry loop in HttpClient.request, which relies on the new isRetryable() and backoffDelay() helpers; the tests add the new config fields and cover the retry behaviour.

groups.title: Rename UserRecord to User
groups.why: Every hunk is the same identifier substitution UserRecord -> User: the declaration in types.ts and all references in validation, cache, service and the service test.

notes: The rename is a symbol rename, not a file rename, so it is a reviewable group of its own rather than part of 'mechanical'. A tool that also collapses it as mechanical still scores perfectly, since it stays one cluster.

Path proximity is a trap here: src/users/* hunks are all rename, but src/http/* and src/config/* are all retry. tests/http/client.test.ts#0 only changes a config literal, so it links to retry through the HttpConfig fields, not through an import.
